chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Ahmad narrated to me, saying: Abu Zuhayr al-Nahdi narrated from Adam ibn Ishaq from Muawiyah ibn Ammar from some of his companions from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Offer the night prayer, for it is the Sunnah of your Prophet and the practice of the righteous before you, and it drives away illness from your bodies.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of performing the night prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), linking the night prayer to the prophetic tradition and the consistent practice of the righteous predecessors. The Imam emphasizes its dual role as both a spiritual discipline and a means of physical purification, describing it as the 'remover of disease' from the body. This reflects the Shia understanding of Salat al-Layl as a holistic act of worship that benefits both the soul and the physical constitution.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Yahya al-’Attar who said it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ahmad who said it was narrated to me by Abu Zuhayr al-Hindi from Adam b. Ishaq from Muawiyah b. Ammar from some of his companions from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “Offer Salaat-e-Shab for it is the Sunnah of Muhammad (s.a.w.s.) and the virtuous that came before you. It removes all the ailments from your body.”
